puzzles.name: Trial of the Statues
puzzles.description: Towering gods demand worship. Several statues hold weapons, while one holds nothing.
puzzles.solution: Kneel only before the statue with no weapon. Choosing wrong is fatal.
puzzles.reward: Unlocks passage to the Fire Chamber.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Instant death → respawn at Guild Hall.

puzzles.name: Lava Stepping Stones
puzzles.description: In Pyros' Fire Chamber, rocks float across a lava river. Some are solid, others crack when stepped on.
puzzles.solution: Time your movements carefully, and hop only on the solid stones.
puzzles.reward: Safe path across the lava river to boss arena.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Fall into lava → lose HP and restart at riverbank.

puzzles.name: Water Cavern Flood Puzzle
puzzles.description: Neressa raises the water level, forcing hunters onto ledges. Coral pillars glow faintly in sequence.
puzzles.solution: Activate the coral pillars in the correct glowing order.

puzzles.name: Earth Fortress Boulder Lock
puzzles.description: Gravemaw blocks the path with enormous rune-marked boulders that rearrange when struck.
puzzles.solution: Strike runes in correct sequence (clues hidden on walls).
puzzles.failureConsequence: Puzzle resets, no progress until correct order is found.

puzzles.name: Air Spire Bridge Gusts
puzzles.description: Zephyra summons fierce gusts across a high bridge. Glowing feathers scatter mid-air.
puzzles.solution: Collect feathers and use them as anchors to weigh down the bridge.
puzzles.reward: Allows safe crossing to Zephyra's throne.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Knocked off bridge → lose HP and restart at bridge start.

puzzles.name: Rune Circle of Shadows
puzzles.description: In the Demon Castle Library, a giant rune circle glows on the floor, shifting constantly. Dark whispers dare entry.
puzzles.solution: Step on runes in the correct order matching the chant.
puzzles.reward: Unlocks hidden grimoire granting shadow power.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Wrong rune = shadow attack (HP loss), puzzle resets.

puzzles.name: Eternal Battlefield Weapon Trial
puzzles.description: Spirits mislead adventurers among scattered weapons. Only one sword can pierce the Final Gate.
puzzles.solution: Choose the rusted sword that glows faintly when lifted.
puzzles.reward: Sword is required to break the seal of the Final Gate, Hunter's Leather Armor.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Choosing wrong weapon = cursed → HP drain / respawn.

puzzles.name: Shadow Army Summoning
puzzles.description: On the Shadow Plains, fallen souls rise but scatter without command.
puzzles.solution: Issue the correct command phrase to bind them.
puzzles.reward: Adds shadows as allies in later battles.

puzzles.name: Monarch's Throne Riddle
puzzles.description: From the obsidian throne, a riddle echoes: "What walks with no legs, speaks with no mouth, and follows yet leads?"
puzzles.reward: Unlocks final throne room and Monarch's audience.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Wrong answer → immediate expulsion from throne room.

puzzles.name: Final Gate Seal
puzzles.description: A colossal rift sealed by four elemental emblems (Fire, Water, Earth, Air).
puzzles.solution: Collect all 4 sigils from bosses and place them into the gate lock.
puzzles.reward: The Final Gate opens → last boss fight / ending.
puzzles.failureConsequence: Missing sigils → gate remains sealed, cannot progress.

puzzles.name: Architect's Test
puzzles.description: Kandiaru, the Architect, forces you to input the correct sequence of glowing runes that represent the System's code.
puzzles.solution: Enter runes in the correct sequence to stabilize the System.
puzzles.failureConsequence: HP drains steadily until puzzle resets.

puzzles.name: Shadow Monarch's Choice
puzzles.description: At the Monarch's Throne, shadows whisper: "Will you embrace dominion or resist?"
puzzles.solution: Choose to embrace shadows or resist shadows.
puzzles.reward: Determines alternate ending path (Shadow Monarch Ending vs Hunter King Ending).
puzzles.failureConsequence: Wrong choice or indecision = lose all Shadow Army allies and get expelled.
